title: Austin Energy Fuel & Mower Contract Change
summary:
*   **Energy Supply Debate:** Considered extending the city's contract for natural gas, a crucial fuel source for its electric power generating facilities.
*   **Equipment Bid Withdrawal:** Faced an issue with an awarded contract when John Deere Company requested to withdraw its bid for a specialized "telescoping slopemower."
*   **New Mower Deal:** Subsequently, the contract for the slopemower was re-awarded to the second-lowest bidder, Rotary Power, Inc., for $6,050.92.
transcript:
=CITY OF AUSTIN. TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 21st day of
March, 1969, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, at 2:00
P.M. for the purpose of considering extension to contract for natural gas fuel for
electric generating facilities, and consider accepting request of John Deere Company to
withdraw bid for one telescoping slopemower awarded by the Council on March 13, 1969, and
awarding contract to the second low bidder, ROTARY POWER, INC., for one telescoping
slopemower at $6,050.92.
